title: Dedup + versioning by PMCID/DOI
context: As ingestion scales, articles can arrive more than once or in updated form, so the corpus needs deduplication and versioning keyed on PMCID/DOI. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Versioning must preserve provenance across updates.
objective: Implement deduplication and versioning of corpus records by PMCID/DOI.
acceptanceCriteria: Deduplicates corpus records by PMCID and DOI; near-duplicate handling is documented.
Versioning by PMCID/DOI implemented so updated articles supersede prior versions without losing provenance.
Tests + CI green; code MIT-licensed; no credentials committed; DCO signed-off.
